Within the intricate combinatorial framework of the *Paṭṭhāna*, this section analyzes conditional relations by pairing the Triplet on Visible Objects (*sanidassanattika*) with the Root Dyad and subsequent dyads (*hetudukādi*) [SuttaCentral].
